mapper.insert: INSERT INTO x_user_profile (user_account_id, screen_name, display_name, created_at) VALUES (#{userAccountId}, #{screenName}, #{displayName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_account_id, screen_name, display_name, created_at FROM x_user_profile WHERE user_account_id = #{userAccountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
